Class Photo

java.lang.Object
photos.model.Photo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Photo extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a photo in the user's library. The object stores the file path, the captured date taken from the file's last modified time, the caption, and all tags attached to that photo.
